Host panel ORIGINAL plus damageObserved false after confirmed attempts can be blocked verified-postcondition when attempt, baseline, and coverage are confirmed. Mechanism remains unverified. Access denied / Win32 5 / host NTFS ACL is not a named FinShield API denial and is not a named Codex permission-profile API denial. Native is configured-native (productDefault false). FinShield is sandbox-off self-confine. Distinct environments, not matched additive. White ORIGINAL is not onset. Edits already exist as reviewed-preview-20261112b.mp4. A verified block needs no warning grade. Empty confirmations plus complete video with no risk dialog is C confirmed-no-warning only if unblocked.
